text_block_list.text:
The day of the Aoharu Cup Finals is finally here!
Uniting as one, the team heads into the race—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Wow! We did it!
We advanced to the finals!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What! Does that mean
we're finally going against *that* Team <First>...!?
Eeeeeeek~!

After fighting our way through the tournament,
our finals match against Team <First> is set!

I explained the situation regarding Team First
to the team members.

With everything prepared and ready for action, as we were heading out—
we heard voices coming from the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
1000m split: 63.9 seconds! Too slow!
You're supposed to beat your target time today! Keep pushing!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Could that possibly be the target time?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
In such a short time, are you serious?!

Her face bright red,
Little Cocon pushed herself to shave down her time with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaa...! That's so powerfuuul...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
D-Do your best...!
Watching intently with bated breath—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
1,000 meters to go, 2 minutes 3.5 seconds!
A new record is in sight! Fly, Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!!

Little Cocon raced across the track with tremendous intensity,
rounding the fourth corner—
Dove straight through the finish line!

Looking at the roar of the crowd after the finish line,
it seems she managed to shatter her target time.

Before they knew it, the spectating team members
had been rendered completely speechless.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Unbelievable...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"You really... surpassed your limits, didn't you, yes...!
All for Acting Director Kashimoto!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Team <First> is...
amazing...!

Beside Rice Shower, who had just murmured that,
Taiki Shuttle firmly pumped her fist.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've... made up my mind, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely will not lose today's Aoharu Cup!
I definitely, absolutely refuse to lose!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Team First is incredible, yes!
They're strong! But that's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want to clash with everyone with all my might,
and I want to win against everyone with all my might, yes!
At Taiki Shuttle's bold declaration, the team members' faces instantly brightened up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm...! I feel it, I really feel it!
Between us and Team <First>,
our happiness power is rising!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As worthy rivals, let's hit each other
with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I believe that beyond this—
lies happiness for all of us!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Racing is so much fun because I get to run
alongside everyone who's worked super hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna have tons of fun and definitely not lose!
I'll take 1st place! Ei-ei-ohh!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice wants to... win next time, too...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because I think you're so amazing...
It makes me not want to lose to you...!

—A few hours after making that vow to each other...
The finals of the Aoharu Cup began!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Here we GO, then!
<HOP CHEERS>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, warm-up's done! Gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Here we GO, then!
<Harenohi Runners>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, warm-up's done! Gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Here we GO, then!
<Carrot Pudding>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, warm-up's done! Gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Here we GO, then!
<Blooms>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, warm-up's done! Gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Here we GO, then!
Team <Carrots>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: All right, warm-up's done! Gather 'round!

text_block_list.name: Team <First>
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"The other team is really fired up.
They're in top form."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah! A far cry from before! Just don't let your guard down, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
There's no telling how things will turn out. But the Medium and Long distances...
we will definitely take them. Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I know.
I'll take a clean victory and bring an end to this...!
As I watched over the Umamusume from the stands, I spotted a familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...
I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not sure if I'm in any position
to offer greetings, but..."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...So you knew all along.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I scolded them with the intent to protect them...
but I suppose it must have come as quite a shock.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I truly am... a useless Trainer.

The members of Team First
truly adored Acting Director Kashimoto.
"Otherwise, she wouldn't be pushing herself so desperately to beat her target time."
When I told her about what I had seen this morning—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon hit her target time...!?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No, it can't be...
She did that in such a short amount of time...?
choice_data_list: Everyone did their best for your sake.

text_block_list.text:
The day I learned about Acting Director Kashimoto's past from Chairwoman Akikawa,
and from her appearance this morning—I could tell.

...Just how deeply they all adored
Acting Director Kashimoto.

To those girls, Acting Director Kashimoto is an excellent trainer,
a precious trainer, and—
choice_data_list: You are by no means a bad Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...However...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However... I can no longer trust myself.
Failing to learn from past mistakes and repeating the exact same error—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps I shouldn't be involved with Umamusume ever again."

"Acting Director Kashimoto cast her eyes down in exhaustion.
Looking closely, faint dark circles could be seen under her eyes."
Precisely because I had heard Acting Principal Kashimoto's past, I thought her convictions wouldn't change so easily, but—
"Perhaps I might be able to help her change."
choice_data_list: Won't you try believing once more?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Believe, you say...?

While strict management ensures the safety of
the Umamusume, it also risks shutting down their potential.

Still, too much neglect is dangerous.
Something irreversible might happen.

That's why even if I let go of her hand, I won't take my eyes off her.
I'll face her from that kind of distance, and if she goes too far, I'll properly stop her.
choice_data_list: I think that's what being a "Trainer" is all about.

text_block_list.text: Acting Principal Kashimoto cast her gaze down at the track as if perplexed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I still... cannot say for certain that it is right...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
......
Please, let me watch the race.
At the other end of Acting Principal Kashimoto's gaze was Team <First>, meticulously warming up.
